description: This file defines a PHP class that transforms HTML FONT tags into SPAN tags with corresponding CSS styles by converting font attributes like color, face, and size into CSS styles.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform_Font
classes.description: A class that converts FONT tags to SPAN tags with CSS styles representing font attributes such as color, face, and size.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a FONT tag into a SPAN tag with inline CSS styles based on the font attributes provided (color, face, size).
